text: Based on the evidence, not all of the 2021 loss was inside the pine plantation. While 68.1 hectares of the 81.3 hectares of loss were within the planted forest, 13.2 hectares of the loss occurred outside the mapped forest area. The planted species in the affected area were Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. The loss could be due to various reasons such as harvesting, fire, or storm, but the exact cause is not established by this evidence.
